column1: # The inventory to expect for a boss. Written for this plugin (October 2026); what a fight needs was
# read from the OSRS Wiki page of each boss.
# kind: mapped = an inventory is suggested for the boss · need = the fight cannot be done without it (listed even
# when not owned) · take = only when owned ·
# food = fills what is left · only = the boss takes none of the usual supplies below.
# boss "*" = every boss; "*melee", "*ranged", "*magic" = the style of the set that was picked.
# A quantity ending in "s" is one stack. A name starting with "~" matches any item with the rest in its name.
# A potion is written without its dose: the fullest one owned is taken.
